name: Blind
effect: Fully blind a target by stacking junk images all over its vision.

name: Broadcast
effect: Display yourself on a surface and communicate with the target. During this time any diver may look for the hacker by opposing the user’s test using his own \hackingskill +10.
multipletargets: everyone in the vicinity can see the broadcast, but divers searching for the user gain an additional +20.

name: Misinform
effect: Overwrite the info displayed on a news board. For the new information to sound believable, the user must pass a \emph{Stories} test in addition to his \hackingskill.
multipletargets: the duration is reduced to one minute and the \emph{Stories} test takes a -10 penalty, representing more people being critical of the message.

name: Wall
effect: Construct a two-dimensional wall up to 2 by 2 meters in size.
multipletargets: this hack takes an additional -20 penalty.
